query: Can I get pregnant from precum?
gw_message: Under Kenya's 2020 national school re-entry guidelines, a pregnant learner is allowed to stay in school for as long as possible and to sit national exams if her health allows. After delivery she is re-admitted to the same class she was in before. The guidelines give the return time as six months after delivery and also as the start of the next calendar year, so ask your school's guidance and counselling teacher what applies to you.
